test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Unless __you don’t answer my question__ , I will not leave.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence expresses a condition** (unless)** followed by a consequence **(I will not leave).**
 
• The underlined segment **"you don’t answer my question"** negates the condition itself.
 
• We need a clause that states the condition for the speaker to leave, which is the person being addressed answering the question.
 
• Hence, The correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'You answer my question.'**

Correct answer is__** 'Unless you answer my question, I will not leave.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (1) - "you don't answer this question"** negates the condition and uses "this question" which sounds redundant in the context.
 
• **Option (2) - "I don't answer my question" ** makes no sense grammatically. The speaker wouldn't be waiting for themselves to answer their own question.
 
• **Option (4) - "you don't question my answer"** introduces a new idea of questioning the answer, which is not the original condition set in the sentence.
